rec.name: PDP Model & Fit Info Bar (Passform)

what.text: A slim info bar attached to the product image gallery on the PDP. It shows a fit statement fed by a product metafield, for example "Our model is 1.70 m tall and wears size S". The bar can sit as an overlay at the bottom of the image or directly below it. It has an optional leading icon (ruler/tag, image or SVG) and supports bold text via rich text. The ticket was filed as a "Section"; the delivered code is a theme block with a snippet, added to the product section.

why.text: Size uncertainty is the main barrier to buying clothing online and a leading cause of returns. Showing the model's height and the size they wear gives shoppers a concrete reference point right where they judge the product, so they can estimate their own fit. This lowers perceived risk, speeds up size selection and should reduce size-related returns. Placing it directly at the image keeps it in the shopper's line of sight and avoids a trip to a size chart.

how.text: 1) Create a product metafield "CRO | PDP | Passform" (namespace and key standard.cro_pdp_passform, single line text) and fill it per product, e.g. "Unser Model ist 1,70 m groß und trägt Größe S". 2) Create snippets/cro_pdp_passform.liquid. It renders only if the metafield has a value, outputs the icon plus the text, and applies the block settings as inline CSS. 3) Register a block of type cro_pdp_passform (limit 1) in the product section schema with the settings below. 4) Render the snippet inside the section's block loop (case/when or if/elsif), placed near the media gallery wrapper. 5) In the theme editor, add the block, set the style and position, then QA on desktop and mobile. The Overlay mode uses position:absolute at the bottom of the image. The optional "Hide image whitespaces" setting makes the gallery full-width on mobile. The screenshots show a later app-style variant ("CRO | Fit") with a rich-text content field and a "Hide if metafield is not available" toggle. The code file in the ticket does not contain those two features.

items: Icon as image (image picker, 18x18 px recommended)
Icon as SVG (HTML field; overrides the image icon; default ruler-style SVG)
Hide at Desktop (show on mobile only)
Fit position: Overlay on image / Below image (default Below image)
Space left-right / inner padding (0–30 px, default 16)
Text alignment: Left / Center / Right (default Center)
Border bottom on/off and border color (default #E0E6E9)
Gap left-right / outer margin (0–30 px, default 0)
Seen in screenshots: rich-text content field and "Hide if the metafield is not available" toggle

dependencies.text: Product metafield standard.cro_pdp_passform (single line text) must exist and be filled per product. It needs an OS 2.0 theme whose product section supports blocks and a snippet render. The CSS selectors for the full-width mobile option (.product__media-list .product__media-item) are Dawn-like and may need adapting to other themes. The theme should be duplicated before editing. The metafield key shown in the screenshot (standard.cro_pdp_fit) differs from the code file (standard.cro_pdp_passform), so check the key naming per install.
